textures.generator: Z-Image with ComfyUI-Universal-Seamless-Tiles on den-m5 (asset-pipeline tools/materials/tileable_gen.py --tiling seamless --size 1024 --seed 12), the same route as the ground textures (content/game/textures/terrain-studies/prompts.json)
textures.prompt: Natural weathered bedrock surface like a smooth grey cliff face or a large worn boulder: large continuous flat planes and broad soft facets of solid stone, subtle strata bands, a few long thin cracks, cool mid grey and dark charcoal with warm brown-grey weathering stains and faint pale green-grey moss tints. Not individual stones, not cobbles, not pebbles, not paving, no gaps between stones. Seamless tileable square texture for a stylized fantasy survival game, seen straight on, flat orthographic, fills the whole frame edge to edge, continues evenly off all four edges with no focal point. Hand-painted painterly texture in the manner of Valheim and classic 2000s games: broad soft colour patches, readable medium-sized shapes, economical brush marks, no photographic micro-detail, soft even lighting, no cast shadows, no highlights, no objects, no text.
textures.rejected: the first wording (a boulder-stone surface) returned cobble pavements at every seed tried; the bedrock wording above returns continuous rock faces
textures.note: Brightness is high on purpose: a texture is decoded as sRGB where the vertex colours it replaces were read as linear, so a texture of the same average grey draws about 2.4 times darker.
